## [0.2.0-dev.10](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/compare/v0.2.0-dev.9...v0.2.0-dev.10) (2026-09-25)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* correct media grabber hook types ([34cca96](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/commit/34cca96c4dd0a063859b81009bf0e60c66162d9d))

### ✨ New Features

* add ADM direct media grabber ([3b3098f](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/commit/3b3098fb3c6dbd8fd5fdbb3ee9ac0b704b7dc965))

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Skip ADM's app-level ad initialization, display routines, and Telegram join prompt.

patches.name: Disable rating prompts
patches.description: Skip ADM's rating dialog without changing service teardown.

patches.name: Increase connection limits
patches.description: Raise the download slider ceiling to 64 and set torrent defaults to 500 global and 100 per torrent.

patches.name: Media grabber (direct video and subtitles)
patches.description: Capture direct video and subtitle URLs in ADM's browser and offer downloads.
